title: window-left, round 1
meta: 1 candidate, about 13 cents. Seven of eight checks pass; square-on fails on the arch, a check fault.
note: The glass came back empty and keys clean, green clear of every edge, the casement with its latch and stay, the owl roundel in the head. Two things to judge. The window is 1.47 times as tall as it is wide where about 2.25 was asked, so at 1.2 m wide it would stand 1.76 m tall, not 2.7. And the owl is small and drawn as a coloured figure on the glass rather than painted line; it does not touch the ring. Also: a stone transom under the head, and brass hinges where iron was asked.
